{{Quote|Here comes the Forty-first, you can always rely on the infantry.|[[Fi Skirata]]|<ref name="Triple Zero" />}}
The '''41st Elite Legion''', also known as the '''41st Elite Infantry''' or simply the '''41st Elite'''&mdash;and sometimes referred to as the '''41st Elite Corps''' despite its [[Army/Legends|military]] formation, was an [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]'s [[9th Assault Corps/Legends|9th Assault Corps]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Under the command of [[Senior Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Gender/Legends|her]] assigned [[Senior clone commander|Senior Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]], the legion specialized in long-term patrol and peacekeeping operations on [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], with its [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] becoming known as hostile terrain specialists and experts in [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]], counter-[[Terrorist/Legends|insurgency]], and [[Alien/Legends|alien]] recruitment. [[Sarlacc Battalions]] [[Sarlacc Battalion A|A]] and [[Sarlacc Battalion B|B]], as well as [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], belonged to the 41st Elite.

The 41st notably participated in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] towards the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end of the war]], where its troopers turned on their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]]&mdash;including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], upon the activation of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the 41st Elite Legion was re-designated as the '''41st Stormtrooper Legion''' and placed under the command of [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Stormtrooper Commander]] [[Gett]].

==Characteristics==
===Organization===
The 41st Elite Legion<ref name="Insider 87" /> was a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of elite [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that served within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]'s [[9th Assault Corps/Legends|9th Assault Corps]],<ref name="Sideshow" /> itself a unit of the [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third Sector Army]],<ref name="TEGtW-AC9" /> during the pan-[[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Led by [[Senior Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Senior clone commander|Senior Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]],<ref name="Sideshow" /> the 41st was considered the Third Army's best [[Division/Legends|division]]<ref name="TEGtW-AC9" /> and contained 9,216 clone troopers, plus support personnel, subdivided into four [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]].<ref name="Legion structure" /> Alongside standard clone troopers, the unit contained skilled [[AT-RT driver]]s,<ref name="Starships 30" /> [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone sharpshooters]],<ref name="Gauntlet of Death" /><ref name="Starships 30" /> and [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]].<ref name="Sideshow" /> [[Draa/Legends|Draa]] and [[Buzz/Legends|Buzz]] both served in the 41st Legion as enlisted [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]],<ref name="Weapons Factory" /> while [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Faie/Legends|Faie]]<ref name="Insider 87" /><ref name="Faie CSWE">{{CSWECite|1|251|Faie, Commander}}</ref> and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] served as [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="Starships 30" />

[[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]]<ref name="Hasbro TCW Gree" /> and the [[Sarlacc Battalions]], a formation of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] composed of [[Sarlacc Battalion A]] and [[Sarlacc Battalion B]]&mdash;two of the 41st's best units, fell under the 41st Elite.<ref name="Starships 30" /> Among Green Company's ranks were [[Green Leader/Legends|Green Leader]]&mdash;the [[Company/Legends|company's]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|leader]], [[Unidentified Clone Captain (Tranquility)/Legends|a clone captain]],<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" /> [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Rishi)|a clone commander]], and [[Cooker]]&mdash;a clone [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]].<ref name="Gauntlet of Death" /> The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaas Ga]] held command of the Sarlacc Battalions, while trooper [[Fi (clone trooper)|Fi]] was assigned to one of them.<ref name="Triple Zero" />

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the 41st Elite Legion was reorganized as the 41st Stormtrooper Legion, now a legion of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] serving under the command of [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Stormtrooper Commander]] [[Gett]] in the new Imperial [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].<ref name="TEGtW-AC9" />

===Equipment===
By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="CoD date">{{TCWdates|109}}</ref> members of the 41st Elite wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|dark green]] markings,<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" /> lime green markings, or no markings at all.<ref name="Gauntlet of Death" /> Following the implementation of [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]], the 41st Legion maintained a large armory<ref name="GGAR" /> of gray-marked Phase II [[Armor/Legends|armor]]&mdash;the legion's standard armor color,<ref name="Starships 30" /> as well as camouflaged [[clone scout trooper armor]] and Phase II armor<ref name="GGAR" /> specialized for combat in [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] environments.<ref name="Gree DB">{{DB|character|gree|Gree, Commander}}</ref> 

For [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]], the legion's troopers wielded [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]] for heavier engagements and [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] for close-quarters combat.<ref name="CotF preview 3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/CotFPreview3|text=''Champions of the Force'' Preview 3}}</ref> Other weapons used by the unit included the [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]],<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" /> [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]], and the [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|RPS-6 rocket launcher]].<ref name="Weapons Factory" />

The 41st Elite utilized different vehicles during the war, including [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]], [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernauts]], [[Infantry Support Platform/Legends|Infantry Support Platforms]], [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|All Terrain Attack Pods]], [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]], and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]].<ref name="RotS" />

==History==
===The Clone Wars===
Following the eruption of the Clone Wars between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Confederacy of Independent Systems,<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the 41st Elite Legion served in the Grand Army of the Republic under the command of Jedi General Luminara Unduli and her assigned Senior [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] CC-1004, nicknamed Gree.<ref name="GGAR" /> 

[[File:CmdrGree-TCWJA.png|thumb|right|250px|The 41st maintained an excellent service record and elite status throughout the Clone Wars, due to its commander's efforts.]]
Specializing in long-term patrol and peacekeeping operations, frequently operating in primitive and grueling conditions to forge alliances with<ref name="GGAR" /> often hostile native populations,<ref name="Fact File 32">{{FactFile2014|32|GRE1&ndash;4, ''Clone Commander Gree''}}</ref> a task derived from Gree's expertise in alien species,<ref name="CotF preview 1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/CotFPreview1|text=''Champions of the Force'' Preview 1}}</ref> the legion quickly became the unit of choice when local cooperation was needed for the Republic's war effort.<ref name="Starships 30" /> Additionally, the 41st was often tasked with the difficult and dangerous mission of finding and organizing Republic allies in locations where none were thought to exist, training and building them up to fight against Separatist incursions.<ref name="Fact File 32" />

Through Gree's efforts, the 41st earned a reputation for gaining the trust of, and working with local populations effectively&mdash;holding an excellent continuing service record. Due to this, the 41st was designated as an elite unit in its field.<ref name="Starships 30" /> The legion's troopers became known as specialists in hostile terrain warfare, as well as alien recruitment,<ref name="GGAR" /> [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]],<ref name="Fact File 32" /> and counter-[[Terrorist/Legends|insurgency]] experts. The 41st also pioneered the use of the All Terrain Recon Transport and the HAVw A6 Juggernaut, which the unit became particularly adept with, using them for reconnaissance and infantry charges.<ref name="GGAR" /> Additionally, the unit's experience with light transport vehicles, such as the [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] and AT-RT, influenced some of the Republic's military strategies during the war.<ref name="Fact File 32" />

===Skirmish at Dinlo===
{{Quote|Yes, I know I should be directing the battle from the ship. Yes, I know we could reduce the surface of Dinlo to molten slag from orbit. But we can extract more than a thousand men, and that’s worth doing. I asked for volunteers and I got the whole ship’s crew and every man in Improcco Company, and not from blind obedience. Let me try.|Jedi General Etain Tur-Mukan|<ref name="Triple Zero" />}}
[[File:Etain suvudu.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Etain Tur-Mukan (pictured) and Improcco Company saved the 41st Elite's Sarlacc Battalions on Dinlo.]]
367 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the 41st Elite Legion's [[Sarlacc Battalions]] [[Sarlacc Battalion A|A]] and [[Sarlacc Battalion B|B]], under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Gree and Jedi General [[Vaas Ga]], were involved in a [[Skirmish at Dinlo|skirmish]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army]] on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dinlo]]. During the battle, both battalions became pinned down by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces and needed to be rescued as their only exit was cut off. Jedi General [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], wanting to assist the clone forces at Dinlo, assembled the crew of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Fearless]]'', along with the troopers of [[Improcco Company]], to rescue them.<ref name="Triple Zero" />

Arriving at the battle in modified [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier]]s, Etain and the rest of Improcco [[Company/Legends|Company]] rescued 1,058 troopers belonging to the Sarlacc Battalions, evacuating them off-planet to the ''Fearless''. While flying to the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], one of the Sarlacc Battalions' troopers, nicknamed [[Fi (clone trooper)|Fi]], [[Death/Legends|passed away]] while being comforted by Etain, after sustaining a fatal injury to [[Gender/Legends|his]] chest.<ref name="Triple Zero" />

One day later, half of the 41st Elite participated in a chant of ''[[Vode An]]'', meaning "Brothers All" in [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]], with the members of Improcco Company and the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] and [[Omega Squad]]. The 41st's Sarlacc Battalions were then granted short leave on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] the following day, partly as cover for [[Kal Skirata]]'s black ops missions there, and partly as a morale booster.<ref name="Triple Zero" />

===Skirmish on the ''Tranquility''===
[[File:Green_Company.png|thumb|right|250px|Members of Green Company defending the ''Tranquility'']]
One unit of the 41st Elite, [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], would see action on board the Republic Cruiser [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] when the cruiser came under attack from Separatist forces under the command of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. At that time, the ''Tranquility'' carried the Viceroy of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], as prisoner on the ship. Ventress had been sent to either rescue Gunray or silence him, and the ensuing battle caused Green Company to lose eighteen men defending the cruiser.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />

Later, [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]] saw action in the brutal [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|retaking]] of the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], after intelligence had revealed that [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] had built a new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid foundry]] there.<ref name="Weapons Factory" />

===End of the war===
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the 41st Elite saw heavy action in the battle of Kashyyyk against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid invasion force]] sent to seize the world. There, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the 41st Elite fought alongside [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warriors and a small detachment of Jedi against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]].<ref name="RotS" /> While most of their men were transferred to Kashyyyk, a detachment of the 41st Elite was sent to assist in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]].<ref name="Starships 30" />

When [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] initiated [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Commander Gree and his soldiers promptly turned on [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], however Yoda sensed their intent and killed Gree and his fellow clone trooper and managed to escape with the help of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 41st Elite Legion first appeared, albeit unnamed, in {{Film|III}},<ref name="RotS" /> a [[2005]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="41st BTS">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> The legion was later identified in "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an eight-page reference article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 84|84th issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'',<ref name="GGAR" /> published by [[IDG Entertainment]] on [[September 26]], 2005.<ref name="InsiderDate">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref>
